principles.rule: Monetary authority is institutional and collectively governed; founder identity confers no permanent monetary privilege.
One unit of K_M should settle at par across authorized payment surfaces unless a claim is explicitly a different instrument.
Liquidity may expand or contract through declared operations; elasticity must not imply arbitrary permanent wealth creation for insiders.
All issuance, destruction, policy changes and emergency actions must be auditable and attributable.
Nominal transfers cannot guarantee real consumption beyond available productive capacity and imports.
System capital participation should be structurally broad rather than dependent on founder charity.
No individual expert, wallet, institution or governance coalition should acquire unchecked unilateral control.

amendment_contract.ordinary: Smart Vote proposal + transparent deliberation + declared threshold + delayed activation window
amendment_contract.emergency: pre-authorized bounded intervention + automatic expiry + mandatory post-hoc review
